headlines.title: Don't get caught out by new Buy Now Pay Later rules
headlines.summary: New affordability checks mean you could be blocked from using Buy Now Pay Later but here are ways to avoid it.

headlines.title: Kärcher CEO warns Europe faces 'perfect storm' as he calls for economic reforms
headlines.summary: Europe and Germany risk deindustrialisation, Kärcher CEO Hartmut Jenner has warned. He is urging major cuts in bureaucracy, incentives for extra work and a firm EU trade policy towards China and the US.

headlines.title: Russian strikes leave thousands without power in Ukraine, says Zelenskyy
headlines.summary: The Ukrainian president's remarks came as Moscow reported "significant damage" to an industrial facility in Russia's Nizhny Novgorod region.

headlines.title: Thousands of jobs at Virgin Media O2 to be cut
headlines.summary: The broadband provider has not finalised the number of roles to be axed but it will likely be a sizeable chunk of its workforce, the BBC understands.

headlines.title: Kärcher boss: Less regulation, more action to get Europe and Germany fit again
headlines.summary: Kärcher, best known for its pressure washers, recorded €3.5 billion in sales in 2025 and employs 17,000 people worldwide. Its CEO warns of a 'perfect storm' and calls for a fitness plan for Germany and Europe.

headlines.title: India increases growth forecast for fiscal year
headlines.summary: India s Ministry of Finance has increased its growth forecasts for the current fiscal year. But it also warned about inflation, particularly for fuel and energy, amid continued instability in the Middle East.

headlines.title: Commission backs Tusk as he vows no compromise in court showdown
headlines.summary: "Appointing the new judges lies within the power of the Sejm," Commissioner Michael McGrath told POLITICO.

headlines.title: No more washing up: How Airbnb's new house rules have divided hosts and guests
headlines.summary: Airbnb hosts must stop asking guests to wash-up or take out bins under rules coming into force in November.

headlines.title: Where in Europe do people spend over 40% of their income on housing?
headlines.summary: Housing costs take up more than 40% of disposable income for millions of Europeans. Euronews Business takes a closer look at which countries are hit hardest, with experts explaining the drivers.

headlines.title: Volkswagen logs Q3 operating loss of €5.86 billion on Porsche writedown
headlines.summary: The Volkswagen Group has filed its worst quarterly performance since the height of the Dieselgate scandal in 2015. Share prices climbed in response, however, perhaps because the bad news was so well signposted.

headlines.title: UK’s future lies in EU, says Rachel Reeves
headlines.summary: The intervention by the former British chancellor comes ahead of a UK-EU summit later this month.

headlines.title: Crypto firm Binance covers 90% of losses after $6.3bn hack
headlines.summary: The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) says North Korea was responsible for the hack.

headlines.title: EU to impose €2 fee on all packages entering the bloc as of 1 November
headlines.summary: A €3 fee also came into force in July, leading to a 60% drop in small parcel imports over three months. The new rules aim to counter imports from Chinese platforms, whose low prices threaten European retailers.

headlines.title: Russia shadow fleet sanctions: Can the EU act without US?
headlines.summary: The US is reportedly considering ways to convert dark tankers into legitimate vessels, allowing them to transport crude oil that is not subject to sanctions.

headlines.title: How Merz s five-day Asia trip ended up being mostly about Europe
headlines.summary: Security concerns followed the German chancellor to Singapore, Japan and Korea. And his proposal for a new trade alliance is already facing hurdles.

headlines.title: US tech stocks see sharp falls as AI spending nears $1tn
headlines.summary: Shares in Intel continue to fall while the tech-heavy Nasdaq opens at its lowest level in more than two months.

headlines.title: Islamic states prosecutors call for global enforcement coalition
headlines.summary: Law enforcement heads from 46 Islamic states gather in Baku to tackle cross-border financial crime, artificial intelligence and international asset recovery.
